card.title: The Contest Beneath Everything
card.instruction: Interpret each new event as another move in a much larger competition whose true winner may not be visible yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The neighbour returned my ladder cleaned. That's a move in the gardening rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Now my ladder is cleaner than my windows.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede the first round? Not before I've polished his wheelbarrow.

mechanism: A treats a cleaned borrowed ladder as an opening move in a gardening-status rivalry.
confusable: Unlike simple resentment of help, A must counter with another move rather than settle the visible transaction.
comparison: S216-b postpones thanks until a retaliatory favor; S216-a extends the competition beyond a Christmas meal.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
